notes.title: BUG fixes and feature adjustments
notes.content:
BUG FIXED:
1. Solve the problem of sometimes freezing when turning the viewing angle in the office,
Function:
1. The number of rats that Sakura needs to kill in her mouse-killing mission has been increased to 2.

tags.balance_change: 1. The number of rats that Sakura needs to kill in her mouse-killing mission has been increased to 2.

notes.title: Fixed some issues affecting gameplay
notes.content:
1. When entering the game, the elevator is always open to reduce viewing angle bugs.
2. Slightly slow down the walking speed of the Luo, so that he no longer feels like he is floating.
